title: Orchid Counsel
text:
Orchid Counsel

next_step:
send hosted API pricing + sample ingestion guide; schedule 30m POC kickoff

blockers:
legal wants SOC2 certs
need clarity on audit log granularity
data retention policy review

timeline:
2026-02-12: Inbound form -> demo request (marketing site).
2026-02-12: Intro call w/ AE (Maya) + CTO (L. Ramirez). Covered hosted API, US regions, pricing model.
2026-02-14: SE touchpoint (Jordan) — reviewed sample contract corpus, discussed tokenization and PII handling.
2026-02-17: Sent trial credentials, ingestion checklist, sample prompt set.
2026-02-19: Follow-up email — asked for audit logging sample and SOC2 proof (legal).
Planned 2026-02-25: 30m POC kickoff to run search + summarization on 500 contracts subset.

notes:
Inbound SMB — legaltech startup (pre-revenue, paid pilots).
Primary workflow: contract repository search + quick-summaries for attorneys.
Confidential docs. Very sensitive PII (signatures, SSNs occasionally).
Prefer US-only hosting (asked for us-east and us-west options).
Cost sensitivity: moderate — will start on free credits, expect < $2k/mo in early POC.
Latency: interactive search, want median < 300ms for query -> top-5 results (happy with 300-500ms during POC).
Throughput: low — bursty queries from small team (5–10 users), not heavy batch jobs.
Model preference: open / Llama2-family acceptable; asked about Redwood-verified variants and quantized endpoints.
Routing/fallback: wants clear fallback to smaller cheaper model if quota exhausted; auto-degrade acceptable.
Security ask: audit logs must show user id + request id + timestamp + model variant. Legal asked: "Can we get immutable audit exports?"
Retention: default retention for logs OK but want ability to set 7-year retention on select artifacts per compliance team.
SE notes: prepare sample audit log schema, include example log lines and S3 export flow.
Quoted from CTO: "We need to know exactly who looked at what and when — airtight audit trail."
Next: attach SOC2 cert, short FAQ about PII handling, and a minimal ingestion playbook (redaction options).
